notes:
Account: TruthBridge — mid‑sized eDiscovery + compliance platform used by corporate legal teams and outside counsel. Primary contact: VP Product (A. Rosario).  
Summary: evaluating Redwood for a RAG-backed legal discovery feature focused on embeddings + reranking. They host sensitive client documents, strict retention and audit requirements. Prefer VPC/private deployment; open to on-prem for regulated clients.  
Key asks: index scale ~20M documents (historical + attachments), vector dims ~1536 or 2048 depending on model selection, reranking step after retrieval to boost precision for high-stakes searches. Target: median query latency <= 350ms (user-facing), p95 <= 800ms for combined retrieval+rerank for single-query flows. Throughput: steady-state 15 QPS, spikes to 80 QPS during legal review windows. Cost sensitivity: care about cost-per-query at scale — internal target <$0.03/query at 20M docs (embeddings + light rerank).  
Security: must integrate with enterprise SSO (SAML), KMS for envelope keys, audit logs retention 7+ years (per customer obligations), data residency: some clients require EU-only.  
Quote from call: "If we can't show chain-of-custody level auditing and deterministic retention we won't roll to customers." — VP Product.  
Procurement notes: legal/security review already started; INF team requested architecture diagram and threat model. Pricing deck shared (drive). POC expected to include ingestion pipeline, bulk embedding throughput test, and rerank latency SLO demo.  
Sales shorthand: high ACV if platform passes security + scale tests. Heavy involvement from Solutions Engineering and Security.

technical_requirements: Indexing: ~20M documents + attachments (PDF, DOCX, TIFF OCR). Expect average doc text length 1.2k tokens. Embedding strategy: multi-vector per doc (passage-level) + candidate retrieval then cross-encoder or lightweight transformer reranker. Preferred models: open 1536/2048-dim emb models; fallback to smaller quantized models for cost. Latency/throughput targets: 15 sustained QPS, burst to 80 QPS; median end-to-end search <=350ms, p95 <=800ms. Cost targets: <$0.03/query at scale (including retrieval + rerank). Operational needs: prefix/key caching, shard-aware routing, nightly incremental repacks, warm caches for review window spikes. Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route SLO dashboard, audit log export to customer SIEM. POC scope: ingest 1M sample subset, run 10k query workload with expected distribution, validate rerank lift (precision@5) and cost numbers.
